meta_title: S Pegram Decorating | Painter Decorator Newcastle
meta_description: S Pegram Decorating in Newcastle offers professional interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Decorator — Interior & Exterior Specialist
hero_subhead: Expert painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior redecorating, exterior painting, wallpapering, and full project management for your home.
services_subhead: From single-room redecorating to full house refurbishment, we handle interior and exterior projects with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Redecorating
services.desc: Complete interior refreshes including wall preparation, emulsion and feature walls, ceilings, and woodwork. We protect your furniture and keep disruption to a minimum.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional hanging of standard and premium wallpapers, feature walls, and modern wall coverings. Includes old paper removal and surface preparation.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Exterior masonry, woodwork, and rendering painted to weather the Tyne Valley climate. We use premium exterior paints and prepare all surfaces properly.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architrave, and fitted furniture finished to a high standard. We sand, prime, and apply multiple topcoats for a lasting finish.

services.title: Ceiling Repairs & Decoration
services.desc: Artex removal, plasterboard patching, and smooth or textured ceiling finishes. Safe handling of older properties with proper dust containment.

services.title: Full House Refurbishment
services.desc: Multi-room projects managed from start to finish, including coordination with other trades. We work around your schedule to minimise inconvenience.

about_pullquote: I do the work properly the first time, so you don't need us back.
about_para_1: S Pegram Decorating has been serving Newcastle and Gateshead for over 15 years. Starting as a sole trader with a commitment to honest, skilled work, we've built a steady reputation by taking time to understand what our customers really want—and delivering it without cutting corners or hidden costs.
about_para_2: We're proud that most of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a complete house redecorating, we treat every job with the same professionalism and care. We turn up on time, leave your home clean, and stand behind our work.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Our Work

reviews.text: S did our whole lounge and hallway. Really thorough with prep work—moved everything, laid dust sheets, protected the carpets properly. Finished on time and left the place spotless. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We'd been putting off redecorating the bedrooms for ages. S came round, gave us a fair quote, and got on with it without any fuss. The wallpaper work is really neat. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Julie W.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of the house painted before winter. Excellent job, very professional. He knew exactly what he was doing with the old render. Great value and friendly service.
reviews.author: Paul H.
